overall_explanation: The current verifier checks each command entry is an object with string stdout before reading exitCode or hashing stdout. It rejects null and numeric-stdout records, validates the exit code and output digest, and rejects an empty commands array. The tests cover both malformed cases and a valid complete envelope. The supplied provenance correctly treats malformed-before.json as a post-fix passing result; the pre-guard code establishes the earlier null-command failure.
